name: Bramblescar
summary: Across the southern Barrens, Bramblescar's Razormane wage war with the Bristleback across the Gold Road. Thick brambles fortify their settlement.

sections.title: A Thorned Redoubt
sections.body: Bramblescar is carved into the jagged briars of the southern Barrens. The thick, sharp thorns make a vital redoubt for the Razormane quilboar and deter casual wanderers. The tribe is fiercely territorial and hostile to outsiders. They skirmish with anyone who approaches, treating all who are not quilboar as intruders on land blessed by their ancient boar gods.

sections.title: Tribal Blood Feud
sections.body: Bramblescar sits in perpetual tension with Agama'gor, the Bristleback encampment directly across the Gold Road. The rival tribes wage an unrelenting war for dominion over the southern Barrens. Razormane warriors fight Horde travelers along the highway and repel Bristleback raiding parties, keeping them on constant, violent alert.

faq.answer: The Razormane tribe of quilboar lives in Bramblescar. They defend their thorn-choked encampment from rival quilboar and travelers passing through.

faq.q: Why are the quilboar here fighting each other?
faq.answer: The Razormane of Bramblescar and the Bristleback across the road at Agama'gor are bitter enemies, locked in a fierce territorial feud for control of the southern Barrens.
Bramblescar lies in the southern plains of the Barrens, just east of the main Gold Road and across from Agama'gor.

faq.q: Are the quilboar here hostile to the Horde?
faq.answer: Yes. The Razormane view the Horde as invaders on their sacred tribal lands and attack any traveler who wanders close.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you need the Gold Road clear of raids from Bramblescar to travel safely between Crossroads, Camp Taurajo, and the southern frontier.
